Specification: This module defines a very small TLA+ specification used to compare two logically related invariant-style expressions involving functions and sets of functions. The first operator, ErrInv, checks membership of a concrete function in a UNION of a set comprehension over function-set constructors, while OkInv expresses a similar property using an existentially chosen domain directly. The specification has trivial behavior with Init == TRUE and Next == TRUE, no variables, no temporal property beyond these state/action definitions, and no fault model or proof content.
